name: Mesh-to-TSDF Sequence Encoding Pipeline
definition: A pipeline that loads a sequence of triangle meshes matching a printf-style pattern, fits a single similarity transform to their union bounds, converts each frame to a TSDF voxel grid, encodes it into a codec stream, decodes it, and compares the original, uncompressed TSDF, and decoded surfaces.
summary: The Mesh-to-TSDF Sequence Encoding Pipeline converts temporal mesh sequences into compressed TSDF streams using a unified spatial transform and built-in surface verification.
